title: dashboard command: pr land fast-forwards the checkout, --version, pane list --reports, usage fixes
notes:
From the retro over 30 sessions (main d8819041).
1. pr land: after the merge, fast-forward the local checkout of the base branch when it is clean and on that branch (19 git pull + 7 gh pr view after lands). Also: refuse to merge when no checks registered on the head commit within its wait, instead of merging; a repo with no CI configured at all is the exception to keep working.
2. dashboard --version prints the installed build's stamp (version+commit) without starting or raising the app (agents unpacked app.asar 22 times).
3. pane list --reports: every pane's line plus the last message its worker ended a turn with, in one call, kept short (truncate each message).
4. Usage: the dashboard command with nothing after it brings the running app to the front; it should print usage. 'pane --help' prints its verbs under the name 'session'; it should say pane.
Update docs/command and the usage text; these must never raise or restart the running app.
